text: Sorry this is going to be a long one, I've been up since 5 and my brain is mush. I'm looking after my niece who's 2 while her mum's away for a couple of nights. She came down with chickenpox yesterday, spots everywhere, and she's scratching like mad at them. Her temp was 37.9 when I checked about half an hour ago. Apart from the itching she's honestly her usual self, eating her toast, chatting away, playing with her dolls. The other thing is that about an hour ago she was running round the kitchen and bumped her head on the edge of the table. She cried straight away, a proper loud cry, I gave her a cuddle and she calmed down after a couple of minutes. Since then she's been completely normal, back to playing and bossing me about like nothing happened. There's a little red mark on her forehead. I just wanted to check whether there's anything I should be doing for the itching that's safe for a 2 year old, and whether I need to keep an eye on her for anything after the bump. I'm shattered and second guessing everything so any advice would be great x
